title_observed_in_studio_2026-11-13: The Dark-Web Market Secretly Run by Police
description_and_tags_snapshot_2026-11-12:
In 2017, Dutch police secretly took control of Hansa, a dark-web marketplace for illegal goods. Buyers kept placing orders without knowing who was running the site.

Police recorded more than 50,000 transactions and shared around 10,000 foreign buyers’ delivery addresses with Europol. On July 20, the site was shut down and the operation revealed.
